title: Flow-Based Lattice Surgery Optimization with Runtime T Gate Scheduling
summary: Lattice surgery on the surface code is a leading route to fault-tolerant quantum computation. Compiling logical circuits into lattice surgery operations is a pivotal step that determines the resource cost of a computation. Prior compilers build on idealized assumptions, and one that works in practical settings remains to be developed. Existing works are either unscalable or route one gate at a time within a layer, so the embedding depends on the order of gates and opportunities to route many gates at once are lost. In addition, they assume magic states are always available and cost-free,…
